statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is weekend-closed, so current Tail remains low while verified Gulf energy-route disruption keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The scheduled Globex reopen is the principal price-discovery checkpoint for gap persistence, retracement depth and cross-asset alignment.
headline: Gulf energy disruption keeps Stress extreme before NQ price discovery resumes
body: NQ remains closed for the weekend, leaving no live Nasdaq price-path evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure. Verified Saudi pipeline and Hormuz disruptions raise reopening-gap, inflation and yield risk; the first sustained NQ path becomes observable only after Globex reopens.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock hours have published ChatGPT assessments. Tail remained 19%; Stress was 99% through 02:00 UTC and 100% from 03:00 UTC onward, while Confidence stayed 98% and dominantMode remained normal.
outlookSummary: Conditional risk is concentrated at the Sunday Globex reopening and first hours of price discovery. A gap that develops two-way trade or meaningful retracements supports low Tail; repeated extension, shallow pullbacks and aligned oil, yields and volatility would justify escalation.

forecast.analysis: As Asia begins price discovery, conditional Tail can ease if the opening impulse is being retraced. Repeated extension near session extremes would instead keep risk elevated.
Through early Asia, a two-sided range would support further Tail normalization. A renewed directional leg after failed retracements would be the main contrary signal.
By this hour, conditional Tail returns to low if early price discovery has produced meaningful pullbacks. Stress remains high because the energy shock can still transmit through rates.
If Asian trading remains orderly, the absence of repeated extension would further reduce path risk. Cross-asset confirmation remains a checkpoint rather than an assumed fact.
Late-Asia conditions should clarify whether the Sunday gap is being absorbed. Persistent extremes without retracement would be the main reason to deviate from this lower-Tail path.
Approaching Europe, conditional risk stays low if NQ is rotating rather than extending. Oil and Treasury reactions remain important because they can renew directional pressure.
At the European open, any fresh oil or rates repricing could reintroduce directional pressure. Without that alignment, two-way overnight trade would support low Tail.
Once European liquidity is established, the forecast assumes no persistent one-way confirmation. A synchronized equity, yield and volatility move would be the key invalidation.
Mid-European trade is expected to remain a reassessment window rather than an automatic danger period. Tail would rise only if retracements repeatedly fail.
Later European trading shifts attention toward U.S. premarket positioning. Gap carryover matters only if it is accompanied by persistent extension and weak retracement depth.
Ahead of U.S. premarket liquidity, elevated rates or oil could raise Stress again. Tail stays low unless the overnight path has already become directionally efficient.
